Oops, have started to add (i.e. not dissected fields yet),
These fields added now.
should we add the reserved bit (we do for the Activation/Deactivation CE for example)?
Done

value 13 was overwritten to be 0 in line 4670 for the statistics, so this will not work. I guess we stop this hack, keep values 11 to 13, and handle this when tapping around line 6207. We must also change the various tests against LCID 10 to use 10 in DL and 13 in UL in the 9 places where it is used.

Am I right to say that for UL:

- LCIDs 11 and 12 are variable-length CEs, though they have no additional CE data before the CCCH payload?

- LCID 13 has the one byte CE, followed by UL CCCH data

- If LCID 13 appears, it should be considered a data SDU, in the sense that if it is seen, it should be assumed that we've now seen all of the non-data CEs in this PDU?

* LCID 11 and 12 are exactly the same thing as LCID 0, but with an indication for the network that the UE supports category 0 or freq hopping for unicast. That's why is was convenient to remap them to LCID 0 to benefit from the existing code
* LCID 13 is different as it adds extra bytes before the actual CCCH payload, similar to what is done for LCID 0 with a NB-IoT UE (BTW this LCID is only applicable to NB-IoT according to the spec). That's why it needs a dedicated treatment.
* yes when LCDI 13 appears it should be considered as data SDU (like LCID 0)
